propositions: recheck-review currently refuses all findings on the grounds that the fix requires amend + re-push, but this is incorrect for bugfix-size-attestation whose remedy is attesting the plan in the ticket via rebar review-plan

when a bugfix-size-attestation finding exists but the ticket now carries a current valid plan-review attestation, recheck-review should accept the retry rather than forcing a cosmetic code change to re-trigger review

the accept condition must verify exactly one blocking finding (via header count, not rendered line count due to truncation), confirm it is bugfix-size-attestation, resolve the ticket from the commit message trailer, and re-classify the plan-review attestation using the gate's own verifier

recheck-review must refuse if the block contains any finding other than bugfix-size-attestation, if the attestation is absent or in FLAG_VERDICTS (stale-material, mismatch, invalid), or if the classifier returns an infra verdict (unavailable, error)
eligibility must be decided from durable Gerrit state (bot's own vote message and ticket store) with no trust of the requesting comment, and the retrigger path must not write a vote label
